text: The Board confirms that the appointment of these individuals complies with the provisions of the City of Toronto’s Public Appointments Policy and the relevant provisions of the Relationship Framework for Board – Operated Community Centres, as well as the RTCC’s Constitution and By-laws. The following members are continuing their two year terms, which will end in June 2021: Alan Lennon Ryan Acayan Christine Chen John Bradford Julia Peters Caleb Edwards The following are no longer on the Ralph Thornton Community Centre Board of Management due to resignation or expiry of their terms: William Somerville Hamdi Jimali Sharon Ho Ed Nagy Janet Routliffe Megan Lorius The RTCC Board of Management began a search for suitable candidates to fill the vacancies as members’ terms end in June 2020. Notices inviting qualified applicants were sent to all current RTCC members, subscribers,…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed, at the pleasure of Council, the individuals listed below to the Ralph Thornton Community Centre Board of Management for a term of office ending June 2022, or until successors are appointed: Amy Grenon Lisa Pottie Abraham Plunkett-Latimer Maggi Redmonds Shiralee Hudson Ejay Tupe
